expectedComments: Explain the AS-facing contract, selected inputs, exact observations, and the important ownership/boundary rule for: Projects this vector onto a plane whose normal is normalized. Rotates the vector around Axis. @param AngleDeg Rotation in degrees. @param Axis Normalized rotation axis. Returns the cosine between XY projections, treating zero projections as coincident. Projects this vector onto A without requiring A to be normalized. Projects this vector onto a normalized direction. Unwinds Euler degree components to the engine normalized angular range. Returns the XY heading angle in radians. Returns whether points match under the engine point-equality threshold. Returns whether per-axis point differences are below Dist. Returns three-dimensional Euclidean distance.
